events.title: Newly promoted First Division side 선덜랜드 achieve a shock 2–1 league win over FA Cup holders 맨체스터 유나이티드 at Roker Park . 리버풀's 2–1 home win over 애스턴 빌라 leaves them with the only 100% record in the First Division after three games. Leeds go second with a 3–0 home win over 노리치 시티 . 에버턴's 1–0 defeat to 맨체스터 시티 at Maine Road leaves with without a point from their opening three games. There are victories in the Second Division for promotion favourites 밀월 , 셰필드 웬즈데이 , Oldham and 웨스트햄 유나이티드 .
The only league action of the day sees a Mark Robins goal give 맨체스터 유나이티드 a 1–0 away win over 루턴 타운 .
프란츠 베켄바워 is appointed manager at 마르세유 .

리버풀 extend their winning start to the season to four games with a 2–1 away win over 윔블던. Mark Robins is the star of the show for 맨체스터 유나이티드 once again, scoring twice in a 3–1 home win over QPR . 크리스털 팰리스 go second with a 3–0 win at 노리치 시티. 폴 개스코인 scores a hat-trick for 토트넘 홋스퍼 in their 3–0 home win over 더비 카운티 . 에버턴 claim their first point of the season with a 1–1 draw at home to 아스널 . Oldham have a 100% record after four games, remaining top of the Second Division with a 1–0 win at Charlton .
Manager 조 조던 leaves 브리스틀 시티 to return to his native Scotland and become manager of 하트 오브 미들로디언 .

Euro 1992 qualifying: there are great surprises at Landskrona , Sweden , where the Faroe Islands , in their first competitive international match , defeat Austria 1–0. It is the "Waterloo Day" in Austrian football, and national happiness day for Faroes.
England beat Hungary 1–0 in a friendly at Wembley , the first game under 그레이엄 테일러's management.
East Germany plays its last ever international match, defeating Belgium 2–0 in Brussels .

아스널 keep up the pressure on 리버풀 with a 4–1 home win over 첼시, as do 토트넘 홋스퍼 with a 2–0 win at Leeds. Oldham make it five consecutive wins in the Second Division by beating Oxford 3–0 at Boundary Park .
Peter Beardsley scores a hat-trick for 리버풀 in their 4–0 league win over 맨체스터 유나이티드 at Anfield .
Oldham drop points for the first time this season with a 1–1 draw at home to Charlton, who claim their first point of the season in the process.

Dutch team 피테서 makes its European debut with a win (1–0) in Northern Ireland against Derry City in the first round of the UEFA Cup . The only goal is scored by striker Huub Loeffen in the 18th minute.

리버풀 extend their winning start to the season to six games by winning the Merseyside derby 3–2 at Goodison Park . 아스널 keep up the pressure and hold onto second place with a 2–0 win at 노팅엄 포리스트 . Oldham remain top of the Second Division with a 1–0 win over 미들즈브러 at Ayresome Park . 스윈던 타운 draw level with the top three by beating local rivals Oxford 4–2 at the Manor Ground .
이언 라이트 and Mark Bright both score hat-tricks for 크리스털 팰리스 in their 8–0 home win over 사우스엔드 유나이티드 in the League Cup second round first leg at Selhurst Park .
폴 개스코인 scores four goals for 토트넘 홋스퍼 in their 5–0 win over 하틀리풀 유나이티드 (managed by former 토트넘 홋스퍼 defender 시릴 놀스 ) in the League Cup second round first leg at White Hart Lane .

리버풀's 1–0 win over 선덜랜드 at Roker Park gives them a 100% record after seven games, and they extend their lead to six points after 아스널 are held to a 2–2 draw at Leeds. 토트넘 홋스퍼 and 크리스털 팰리스 are level on points with 조지 그레이엄 's men. 맨체스터 유나이티드's title hopes are dented when a 스튜어트 피어스 goal gives 노팅엄 포리스트 a 1–0 win at Old Trafford . Luton climb to sixth place with a 3–1 win over 노리치 시티 at Carrow Road . 셰필드 유나이티드 and 더비 카운티 occupy the bottom places, both winless after seven games. Oldham remain top of the Second Division despite being held to a goalless draw at 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 .

리버풀, with a 100% record after seven games, are First Division leaders by six points at the end of September. The bottom two places are occupied by 셰필드 유나이티드 and 더비 카운티, who have both yet to win a league game this season. In the Second Division, 올덤 애슬레틱 lead the way with 20 points from their opening eight games. The other two automatic promotion places are occupied by 셰필드 웬즈데이 and 노츠 카운티 , and the playoff zone is occupied by 웨스트햄 유나이티드 , 브리스틀 시티 (in contention for a second successive promotion), 스윈던 타운 and Brighton .
